children: Goodtech ASA hereby announces an Extraordinary General Meeting to be held on Thursday, 15 October 2026, at 10:00 AM.
Notice with agenda and registration form is attached.
All general meeting documents will be available on the company's website https://www.goodtech.no/investor.
Mimi K. Berdal, Chairman of the Board, Goodtech ASA

This information has been submitted pursuant to the Securities Trading Act § 5-12 and MAR. The information was submitted for publication, through the agency of the contact persons set out above, at 2026-09-18 08:00 CEST.

title: Notice of Extraordinary General Meeting
